recommended_caption: Apply for LIHEAP as soon as your state opens applications. Funding often runs out.

recommended_alt_text: Close-up of an alarm mounted on a ceiling.
recommended_caption: Put carbon monoxide alarms on every level of your home and outside sleeping areas.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Woman resting in bed while using oxygen through a nasal cannula.
recommended_caption: Tell your utility if you rely on powered medical equipment, and plan for backup power.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Volunteer handing a box of food to another person.
recommended_caption: Ask 211 where food distribution sites and D-SNAP sign-ups are after a disaster.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Lawyer reviewing documents with two clients in an office.
recommended_caption: Disaster legal services and legal aid can help with FEMA appeals, insurance, and landlord problems for free.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: One person handing a house key on a house-shaped keychain to another.
recommended_caption: Get any agreement with your landlord about repairs or rent in writing.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Handyman working on a window during home repairs.
recommended_caption: Ask your Area Agency on Aging about free or low-cost home repair programs for older adults.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Help line worker speaking into a headset at a desk.
recommended_caption: Dial or text 211 to reach a trained specialist who can connect you with local help.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Water boiling in a steel pot on a gas stove.
recommended_caption: Bring water to a rolling boil for at least 1 minute, then let it cool before drinking.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Car stalled on a flooded city street while people wade through the water.
recommended_caption: Don't try to start a car that sat in floodwater. Call your insurer first.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Woman at home looking closely at her laptop screen.
recommended_caption: Check your status at DisasterAssistance.gov and read every FEMA letter in your account.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Older man typing at a desktop computer.
recommended_caption: Apply for Disaster Unemployment Assistance within the deadline your state announces after the disaster.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Two people filling out an online form on a laptop together.
recommended_caption: Have your Social Security number, address, insurance, and bank details ready before you apply.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Hand holding a set of keys at the doorway of a home.
recommended_caption: FEMA rental assistance can help pay for a temporary place while your home is repaired.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Woman mopping a wooden floor in a living room.
recommended_caption: Photograph damage before you clean, and wear gloves and boots during flood cleanup.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Hand reaching into a cooler filled with ice and water bottles.
recommended_caption: Move food to a cooler with ice if the power will be out more than 4 hours.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Water dripping from a leaking pipe outdoors.
recommended_caption: Let faucets drip during hard freezes, and know where your main water shutoff is.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Roof covered in heavy snow with icicles and a chimney during snowfall.
recommended_caption: Watch for sagging ceilings or cracking sounds, which can mean too much snow on the roof.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Two people discussing a renovation inside a partly built wooden interior.
recommended_caption: Get written estimates from licensed, insured contractors before you sign anything.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Person wrapped in a reflective emergency blanket.
recommended_caption: Warm someone with hypothermia slowly with dry layers and blankets, and call 911.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Long icicles hanging from the edge of a snowy roof.
recommended_caption: Large icicles along the eaves can signal an ice dam forming above.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Tree branches coated in ice and icicles.
recommended_caption: Ice-loaded branches and power lines can fall without warning. Stay clear of them.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Grocery store shelves left almost empty.
recommended_caption: Report sharp price jumps on essentials during a declared emergency to your state attorney general.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Hands sorting file folders in a cardboard box.
recommended_caption: Keep copies of IDs, deeds, and insurance papers in a waterproof bag or secure online storage.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Person wrapped in a brown blanket sitting indoors.
recommended_caption: Layer clothing and blankets and close off unused rooms to hold heat during an outage.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Two women clearing a pile of debris outdoors.
recommended_caption: Wear gloves and sturdy boots, and keep debris piles away from power lines and drains.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Car driving down a snowy forest road during a snowstorm.
recommended_caption: If you're stranded, stay with your car, run the engine briefly, and keep the exhaust pipe clear.

recommended_alt_text: Person in a rain poncho adjusting a blue tarp in the rain.
recommended_caption: Make reasonable temporary repairs to prevent more damage, and keep every receipt.

recommended_placement: After the introduction, before the first H2
recommended_alt_text: Tree worker in a safety harness cutting branches with a chainsaw.
recommended_caption: Hire an insured tree service for trees near homes or power lines.

recommended_caption: Take breaks when shoveling. Heavy snow is hard on the heart.
